verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a public API suite for programmatically managing connections, transformations and other features. It covers a Transformations and Libraries API, an HTTP API and Pixel API for sending events, organization usage metrics, programmatic Audit Logs access, and an Event Audit API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, and detail on how complete the management-API coverage is beyond summary descriptions.
